title: Does combining steering with prompting fight itself? Testing instruction-vs-vector conflict

original_idea.body: Cross a safety steering vector with aligned/neutral/opposed prompts; test whether they add, cancel, or collapse. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: if a prompt can override a safety vector, steering fails as a backstop; concrete deployment scenario (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple factorial prompt x vector design; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped factorial (3 prompt conditions x vector) with clear behavioral outcome (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, reproducible interaction study on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Context-sensitivity of steering noted; the explicit prompt-vs-vector conflict map may be partly open.
